verses.original: בְּ֭נִי אַל־ תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח תּוֹרָתִ֣י לִבֶּֽךָ׃ יִצֹּ֥ר וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י
verses.transliteration: bə·nî ’al- tiš·kāḥ tō·w·rā·ṯî lib·be·ḵā yiṣ·ṣōr ū·miṣ·wō·ṯay
verses.literal: My son do not forget my teaching but let your heart keep my commandments

verses.original: כִּ֤י יוֹסִ֥יפוּ אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים וּשְׁנ֣וֹת וְ֝שָׁל֗וֹם חַיִּ֑ים לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî yō·w·sî·p̄ū ’ō·reḵ yā·mîm ū·šə·nō·wṯ wə·šā·lō·wm ḥay·yîm lāḵ
verses.literal: for they will add length to your days years and peace to your life

verses.original: אַֽל־ חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֗ת יַעַ֫זְבֻ֥ךָ קָשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל־ גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל־ ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ ya·‘az·ḇu·ḵā qā·šə·rêm ‘al- gar·gə·rō·w·ṯe·ḵā kā·ṯə·ḇêm ‘al- lū·aḥ lib·be·ḵā
verses.literal: Never let loving devotion or faithfulness leave you bind them around your neck write them on the tablet of your heart

verses.original: וּמְצָא־ חֵ֖ן וְשֵֽׂכֶל־ ט֑וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאָדָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·mə·ṣā- ḥên wə·śê·ḵel- ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nê ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Then you will find favor and high regard . . . in the sight of God and man

verses.original: בְּטַ֣ח אֶל־ יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־ לִבֶּ֑ךָ תִּשָּׁעֵֽן׃ אַל־ וְאֶל־ בִּֽ֝ינָתְךָ֗
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭaḥ ’el- Yah·weh bə·ḵāl lib·be·ḵā tiš·šā·‘ên ’al- wə·’el- bî·nā·ṯə·ḵā
verses.literal: Trust in the LORD with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding

verses.original: בְּכָל־ דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ דָעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יְיַשֵּׁ֥ר אֹֽרְחֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵe·ḵā ḏā·‘ê·hū wə·hū yə·yaš·šêr ’ō·rə·ḥō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: in all your ways acknowledge Him and He will make your paths {straight}

verses.original: תְּהִ֣י אַל־ חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ יְרָ֥א אֶת־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: tə·hî ’al- ḥā·ḵām bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā yə·rā ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·sūr mê·rā‘
verses.literal: Be not wise in your own eyes fear - the LORD and turn away from evil

verses.original: תְּהִ֣י רִ֭פְאוּת לְשָׁרֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝שִׁקּ֗וּי לְעַצְמוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·hî rip̄·’ūṯ lə·šār·re·ḵā wə·šiq·qui lə·‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: This will bring healing to your body and refreshment to your bones

verses.original: כַּבֵּ֣ד אֶת־ יְ֭הוָה מֵהוֹנֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מֵרֵאשִׁ֗ית כָּל־ תְּבוּאָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kab·bêḏ ’eṯ- Yah·weh mê·hō·w·ne·ḵā ū·mê·rê·šîṯ kāl- tə·ḇū·’ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Honor - the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your crops

verses.original: אֲסָמֶ֣יךָ וְיִמָּלְא֣וּ שָׂבָ֑ע יְקָבֶ֥יךָ יִפְרֹֽצוּ׃פ וְ֝תִיר֗וֹשׁ
verses.transliteration: ’ă·sā·me·ḵā wə·yim·mā·lə·’ū śā·ḇā‘ yə·qā·ḇe·ḵā yip̄·rō·ṣū wə·ṯî·rō·wōš
verses.literal: then your barns will be filled with plenty and your vats will overflow with new wine

verses.original: בְּנִ֣י אַל־ תִּמְאָ֑ס מוּסַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה וְאַל־ תָּ֝קֹ֗ץ בְּתוֹכַחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nî ’al- tim·’ās mū·sar Yah·weh wə·’al- tā·qōṣ bə·ṯō·w·ḵaḥ·tōw
verses.literal: My son do not reject the discipline of the LORD and do not loathe His rebuke

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶ֥ת יְהוָ֣ה יוֹכִ֑יחַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶאֱהַ֣ב וּ֝כְאָ֗ב אֶת־ בֵּ֥ן יִרְצֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṯ Yah·weh yō·w·ḵî·aḥ ’ă·šer ye·’ĕ·haḇ ū·ḵə·’āḇ ’eṯ- bên yir·ṣeh
verses.literal: for - the LORD disciplines the one He loves as [does] a father - the son [in whom] he delights

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מָצָ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝אָדָ֗ם יָפִ֥יק תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê ’ā·ḏām mā·ṣā ḥāḵ·māh wə·’ā·ḏām yā·p̄îq tə·ḇū·nāh
verses.literal: Blessed [is] the man who finds wisdom the man who acquires understanding

verses.original: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב סַ֭חְרָהּ מִסְּחַר־ כָּ֑סֶף תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃ וּ֝מֵחָר֗וּץ
verses.transliteration: kî ṭō·wḇ saḥ·rāh mis·sə·ḥar- kā·sep̄ tə·ḇū·’ā·ṯāh ū·mê·ḥā·rūṣ
verses.literal: for she is more profitable . . . than silver and her gain [is better] than fine gold

verses.original: הִ֭יא יְקָ֣רָה מִפְּנִיִּים וְכָל־ לֹ֣א חֲ֝פָצֶ֗יךָ יִֽשְׁווּ־ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hî yə·qā·rāh mip·pə·nī·yīm wə·ḵāl lō ḥă·p̄ā·ṣe·ḵā yiš·wū- ḇāh
verses.literal: She is more precious than rubies nothing . . . you desire compares with her

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים בִּֽימִינָ֑הּ בִּ֝שְׂמֹאולָ֗הּ עֹ֣שֶׁר וְכָבֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·reḵ yā·mîm bî·mî·nāh biś·mō·w·lāh ‘ō·šer wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: Long life is in her right hand in her left hand [are] riches and honor

verses.original: דְּרָכֶ֥יהָ דַרְכֵי־ נֹ֑עַם וְֽכָל־ נְתִ֖יבוֹתֶ֣יהָ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: də·rā·ḵe·hā ḏar·ḵê- nō·‘am wə·ḵāl nə·ṯî·ḇō·w·ṯe·hā šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: All her ways . . . are pleasant and all her paths [are] peaceful

verses.original: הִ֭יא עֵץ־ חַיִּ֣ים לַמַּחֲזִיקִ֣ים בָּ֑הּ וְֽתֹמְכֶ֥יהָ מְאֻשָּֽׁר׃פ
verses.transliteration: hî ‘êṣ- ḥay·yîm lam·ma·ḥă·zî·qîm bāh wə·ṯō·mə·ḵe·hā mə·’uš·šār
verses.literal: She is a tree of life to those who embrace her and those who lay hold of her are blessed

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יָֽסַד־ אָ֑רֶץ בְּחָכְמָ֥ה כּוֹנֵ֥ן שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם בִּתְבוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yā·saḏ- ’ā·reṣ bə·ḥā·ḵə·māh kō·w·nên šā·ma·yim biṯ·ḇū·nāh
verses.literal: The LORD founded the earth by wisdom and established the heavens by understanding

verses.original: בְּ֭דַעְתּוֹ תְּהוֹמ֣וֹת נִבְקָ֑עוּ וּ֝שְׁחָקִ֗ים יִרְעֲפוּ־ טָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḏa‘·tōw tə·hō·w·mō·wṯ niḇ·qā·‘ū ū·šə·ḥā·qîm yir·‘ă·p̄ū- ṭāl
verses.literal: By His knowledge the watery depths were broken open and the clouds dripped with dew

verses.original: בְּ֭נִי אַל־ יָלֻ֣זוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ נְצֹ֥ר תֻּ֝שִׁיָּ֗ה וּמְזִמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nî ’al- yā·lu·zū mê·‘ê·ne·ḵā nə·ṣōr tu·šî·yāh ū·mə·zim·māh
verses.literal: My son do not lose sight of this Preserve sound judgment and discernment

verses.original: וְיִֽהְי֣וּ חַיִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְ֝חֵ֗ן לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yih·yū ḥay·yîm lə·nap̄·še·ḵā wə·ḥên lə·ḡar·gə·rō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: They will be life to your soul and adornment to your neck

verses.original: אָ֤ז תֵּלֵ֣ךְ דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ לָבֶ֣טַח וְ֝רַגְלְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִגּֽוֹף׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz tê·lêḵ dar·ke·ḵā lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ wə·raḡ·lə·ḵā lō ṯig·gō·wp̄
verses.literal: Then you will go on your way in safety and your foot will not stumble

verses.original: אִם־ תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב לֹֽא־ תִפְחָ֑ד וְ֝שָׁכַבְתָּ֗ שְׁנָתֶֽךָ׃ וְֽעָרְבָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: ’im- tiš·kaḇ lō- ṯip̄·ḥāḏ wə·šā·ḵaḇ·tā šə·nā·ṯe·ḵā wə·‘ā·rə·ḇāh
verses.literal: When you lie down you will not be afraid when you rest your sleep will be sweet

verses.original: אַל־ תִּ֭ירָא פִּתְאֹ֑ם מִפַּ֣חַד וּמִשֹּׁאַ֥ת כִּ֣י תָבֹֽא׃ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rā piṯ·’ōm mip·pa·ḥaḏ ū·miš·šō·’aṯ kî ṯā·ḇō rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: Do not fear sudden danger or the ruin that overtakes the wicked

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְ֭הוָה יִהְיֶ֣ה בְכִסְלֶ֑ךָ וְשָׁמַ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מִלָּֽכֶד׃
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh yih·yeh ḇə·ḵis·le·ḵā wə·šā·mar raḡ·lə·ḵā mil·lā·ḵeḏ
verses.literal: for the LORD will be your confidence and will keep your foot from the snare

verses.original: אַל־ תִּמְנַע־ ט֥וֹב מִבְּעָלָ֑יו בִּהְי֨וֹת יָדֶיךָ לְאֵ֖ל לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tim·na‘- ṭō·wḇ mib·bə·‘ā·lāw bih·yō·wṯ yå̄·ḏɛ·ḵå̄ lə·’êl la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: Do not withhold good from the deserving when it is within your power to act

verses.original: אַל־ תֹּ֘אמַ֤ר לְרֵעֶיךָ לֵ֣ךְ וָ֭שׁוּב וּמָחָ֥ר אֶתֵּ֗ן וְיֵ֣שׁ אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tō·mar lə·rē·ʿɛ·ḵå̄ lêḵ wā·šūḇ ū·mā·ḥār ’et·tên wə·yêš ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: Do not tell your neighbor Come back tomorrow [and] I will provide when you already have the means . . .

verses.original: אַל־ רָעָ֑ה תַּחֲרֹ֣שׁ עַל־ רֵעֲךָ֣ וְהֽוּא־ לָבֶ֣טַח יוֹשֵׁ֖ב אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- rā·‘āh ta·ḥă·rōš ‘al- rê·‘ă·ḵā wə·hū- lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ yō·wō·šêḇ ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: Do not devise evil against your neighbor for he trustfully dwells beside you

verses.original: אַל־ תָּרוֹב עִם־ אָדָ֣ם חִנָּ֑ם אִם־ גְמָלְךָ֣ לֹ֖א רָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tå̄·rōḇ ‘im- ’ā·ḏām ḥin·nām ’im- ḡə·mā·lə·ḵā lō rā·‘āh
verses.literal: Do not accuse . . . a man without cause when he has done you no harm

verses.original: אַל־ תְּ֭קַנֵּא חָמָ֑ס וְאַל־ בְּאִ֣ישׁ תִּ֝בְחַ֗ר בְּכָל־ דְּרָכָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·qan·nê ḥā·mās wə·’al- bə·’îš tiḇ·ḥar bə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵāw
verses.literal: Do not envy a violent . . . man or choose any of his ways

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְהוָ֣ה תוֹעֲבַ֣ת נָל֑וֹז וְֽאֶת־ סוֹדֽוֹ׃ יְשָׁרִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ nā·lō·wz wə·’eṯ- sō·w·ḏōw yə·šā·rîm
verses.literal: for the LORD detests the perverse . . . but He is a friend to the upright

verses.original: מְאֵרַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה בְּבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע יְבָרֵֽךְ׃ וּנְוֵ֖ה צַדִּיקִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: mə·’ê·raṯ Yah·weh bə·ḇêṯ rā·šā‘ yə·ḇā·rêḵ ū·nə·wêh ṣad·dî·qîm
verses.literal: The curse of the LORD is on the house of the wicked but He blesses the home of the righteous

verses.original: אִם־ הֽוּא־ לַלֵּצִ֥ים יָלִ֑יץ יִתֶּן־ חֵֽן׃ וְלַעֲנִיִּים
verses.transliteration: ’im- hū- lal·lê·ṣîm yā·lîṣ yit·ten- ḥên wə·la·ʿă·nī·yīm
verses.literal: - He mocks the mockers but gives grace to the humble

verses.original: חֲכָמִ֣ים יִנְחָ֑לוּ כָּ֭בוֹד וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מֵרִ֥ים קָלֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: ḥă·ḵā·mîm yin·ḥā·lū kā·ḇō·wḏ ū·ḵə·sî·lîm mê·rîm qā·lō·wn
verses.literal: The wise will inherit honor but fools are held up to shame
